league.name: owners-table-v1
league.description: The owner's table: the ten precons the owner's group plays (DESIGN.md section 29: seven identified from photographs of the deck boxes on 2026-11-12, each commander checked against its card image and Forge's deck file, and three named as popular; Blight Curse, Veloci-Ramp-Tor, Mutant Menace and Squirreled Away are also the frozen benchmark pod). A league of these decks alone, and the pool a playtest of one of the owner's own lists draws its opponents from (runner/ab.py --deck-file ... --pool runner/leagues/owners-table-v1.json --opponent-playbooks): a deck that has a shipped playbook (playbook/precons/<id>.json) is seated under it, the others under stock Forge AI, so what this table is depends on the day; DESIGN.md section 30 and playbook/bots.json say which decks have one. If this list ever changes, that is a new league with a new name.

decks.name: Squirreled Away
decks.note: Chatterfang, Squirrel General is in the 99 as shipped
